title: Remove a custom icon from a file or folder
summary: Use the `fileicon` tool to remove a previously set custom icon, restoring the default system icon for a file or directory.

steps.explain: Run the `fileicon rm` command with the path to the file or directory to remove its custom icon.

placeholders.name: FILE_OR_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the file or folder to remove the custom icon from.
